title: 1962 Air Nautic Boeing 307 crash

agencies.name: Bureau of Enquiry and Analysis for Civil Aviation Safety

summary: A 22-year-old Boeing 307 on a charter flight made insufficient preparation for the flight and committed serious navigation errors, incorrectly estimating the aircraft's position. The crew failed to maintain the cruising altitude from the flight plan, did not properly monitor navigation, and descended prematurely, entering instrument conditions before striking Monte Renoso mountain with all 25 occupants killed.
probable_cause: The accident was caused by a series of errors made by the crew who made insufficient preparation for the flight and committed serious errors in estimating the duration and position of the aircraft, failed to observe the cruising altitude entered on the flight plan, and initiated descent prematurely below safe altitude. The operator contributed through inadequate oversight and deficient line procedures on the Bastia-Ajaccio route.

factors.evidence: Crew failed to observe the cruising altitude entered on the flight plan and check properly the navigation of the aircraft, which resulted in a wrong estimation of the position of the aircraft (Conclusions, p. 28)
The crew failed to maintain a safe altitude and started the descent prematurely (Conclusions, p. 28)
A series of errors had been made by the crew who made insufficient preparation for the flight and committed a serious error in estimating the duration of the flight (Conclusions, p. 28)
Air Nautic lacked a chief pilot and autonomous operations service at the time of the accident; inadequate line procedures for the Bastia-Ajaccio route (Conclusions, p. 28)
Aircraft struck Monte Renoso mountain (Conclusions, p. 28)

events.text: Aircraft departed Bastia airport for Nice on charter flight
Aircraft cruising but crew failed to observe the cruising altitude entered on flight plan
Crew made errors in position estimation and navigation monitoring, incorrectly determining aircraft location
Crew initiated descent prematurely without proper position confirmation based on erroneous position estimate
Aircraft entered poor meteorological conditions with reduced visibility during descent
Aircraft entered instrument flight conditions as descent continued below safety altitude for terrain
Aircraft passed through altitude where it should have been clear of Monte Renoso terrain
Aircraft struck Monte Renoso mountain at approximately 2000 meters altitude; all 25 occupants killed

safety_changes: Enhanced requirements for crew training on navigation procedures

notes: French language BEA report read through Conclusions section
Report details crew navigation errors and premature descent as causal factors
Organizational factors noted regarding Air Nautic's operations oversight
No formal written recommendations extracted from report
